name: @onehumanai/sdk
description: OneHuman browser SDK: tells your server, from inside the page, when an AI agent (Claude in Chrome, ChatGPT agent, Codex, Comet…) takes over a signed-in session, and hides marked values the moment one attaches. Pairs with @onehumanai/express, which also serves this file at /onehuman/sdk.js.
author: OneHuman <founders@onehuman.ai>
